item.title: A record three Clubs strike gold in EFL's Equality Code of Practice
item.description: Middlesbrough, Plymouth Argyle and Salford City have all achieved Gold in the first wave of 2025/26 Equality Code of Practice (ECOP) results, the highest possible standard and a landmark moment for the programme. They’re the first of 13 Clubs to receive their results this season, each demonstrating exceptional commitment to putting equality, diversity and inclusion at the heart of how they operate. item.title: Everything you need to know ahead of transfer deadline day
item.description: With the winter transfer window closing soon, below we've rounded up everything you need to know ahead of transfer deadline day in the EFL. When does the Winter transfer window close? The transfer window has been open from 1 January 2026 and will be closing at 7pm GMT on Monday, 2 February. The deadline is scheduled for February as January 31 falls on a weekend. Clubs in all leagues will still be able to sign free agents after the February deadline.
